entries.zh: 护卫舰是一个帝国可以建造的第一级军事舰船。它们行动迅速，轻活灵便，且造价便宜。
entries.en: Corvettes are the first military ship class available for empires. They are fast, nimble and cheap.

entries.zh: 雷击舰是护卫舰的一种先进衍生型号，专职发射鱼雷。他们更慢更脆弱，但可以对大型目标造成毁灭性的打击。
entries.en: Frigates are an advanced variant of the Corvette that specialize torpedo delivery. They may be slower and more vulnerable, but can be devastating against large targets.

entries.zh: 驱逐舰相比护卫舰牺牲了一部分的灵活性与速度来换得更强大的火力与更结实的船体。
entries.en: Destroyers trade the agility and speed of a Corvette for more firepower and a thicker hull.

entries.zh: 巡洋舰是拥有相当耐久度的多面手，既能抵挡攻击，又能司职伤害输出的角色。
entries.en: Cruisers are versatile and durable, capable of both soaking up and delivering damage.

entries.zh: 战列舰造价昂贵，但十分强力。它们的射程极长，甚至能让对手在反击之前就已经受到重创。
entries.en: Battleships are expensive but powerful. With their great firing range, they excel at injuring an opponent before they can strike back.

entries.zh: 尽管泰坦本身就无比强大，但他们还是可以用光环来增强友方舰船。
entries.en: Though they are immensely powerful in and of themselves, Titans can also use Aura abilities to boost friendly ships.

entries.en: $SHIP_GRAPHICS_TITAN_DESC$

entries.zh: 对于任何一个帝国来说，建造一艘主宰都是一项伟大的工程。这些巨大的舰船既可以作为移动船厂，也可以作为支援船。
entries.en: Building a Juggernaut is a great undertaking for any empire. These massive ships function both as mobile shipyards and support vessels.

entries.zh: 这些强大的舰船并没有安装针对敌方舰船的武备，相反，他们的任务就是抹杀整个星球。
entries.en: These immense ships are not equipped to fight hostile fleets, but their job is instead to neutralize entire worlds.

entries.zh: 哨站是最低等级的恒星基地，除了宣示某个恒星系的所有权之外并没有其他功能。
entries.en: An Outpost is the lowest level of a starbase, having little function except marking ownership of a star system.

entries.zh: 擎天堡是恒星基地的最高等级。由于装备着巨量的防御设施，一座擎天堡对于敌方舰队而言绝对是难啃的骨头。
entries.en: A Citadel is the highest upgradeable level of a starbase. Equipped with immense defenses, a Citadel is a hard nut for any enemy to crack.

entries.zh: 运输船在战争中载着那些进攻敌方行星的军队。由于运输船无武装且无防护，它们需要舰队护航以进入敌对领土。
entries.en: Transport Ships carry armies to assault hostile planets during a war. Being unarmored and unarmed, they require a supporting fleet when in hostile territory.

entries.zh: 科研船主要用于探索新的恒星系和研究异常现象。由于是民用船只，它们没有装备武器，十分脆弱。
entries.en: Science Ships are primarily used to explore new star systems and research anomalies. Being a civilian ship, they are unarmored and vulnerable.

entries.zh: 工程船对于建造任何空间站都是不可或缺的。由于是民用船只，它们没有装备武器，十分脆弱。
entries.en: Construction Ships are necessary for building any space station. Being a civilian ship, they are unarmored, unarmed and vulnerable.

entries.zh: 殖民船可以从已定居的行星出发，前往新的行星进行殖民。由于是民用船只，它们没有装备武器，十分脆弱。
entries.en: Colony Ships carry settlers from settled planets to new ones for colonization. Being a civilian ship, they are unarmored, unarmed and vulnerable.

entries.zh: 一件巨大的的防御性武器，发射毁灭性的能量喷流，杀伤敌军舰船。它缓慢但强力，可以有效遏止不速之客。
entries.en: A massive defensive weapon that fires devastating energy blasts, crippling enemy ships. Slow but powerful, it serves as a formidable deterrent to unwelcome visitors.

entries.zh: 防御平台是一种设计用于保护恒星基地不受敌对势力侵犯的固定轨道工事。
entries.en: Defense Platforms are stationary orbital fortifications designed to protect starbases from hostile incursions.

entries.zh: 一座用作星系防御第一线的轨道站。设计用于投射力量、守卫战略要地。
entries.en: An orbital station, serving as the first line of system defense. Designed to project power and secure strategic locations.

entries.zh: 布满武器阵地和防御系统的先进据点。它专为长期交战强化，可以在有争议的宇域中迟滞舰队。
entries.en: An advanced stronghold bristling with weapon emplacements and defensive systems. Reinforced for prolonged engagements, it anchors fleet operations in contested space.

entries.zh: 这座巨大的空间站是深空工事的巅峰，几乎是坚不可摧的堡垒，可以在保持星系后勤运作的同时抵御各种规模的袭击。
entries.en: The pinnacle of deep-space fortification, this massive station is a near-impregnable bulwark, capable of withstanding full-scale assaults while exerting total control over system logistics.

entries.zh: 描述
entries.en: Description

entries.zh: 一种由自我复制的纳米机器人组成的机动灵活的舰载机。由于没有传统的飞行员，这些自主的蜂群以绝对的数量压倒敌人，以无情的精确摧毁敌人的防御。
entries.en: A fast and erratic strike craft composed of self-replicating nanites. Lacking conventional pilots, these autonomous swarms overwhelm foes through sheer numbers, dissolving enemy defenses with relentless precision.

entries.zh: 拦截舰是一种由自我复制的纳米机器人组成的自适应舰载机，将协调而非混沌作为优先事项。作为一个整体的单位，这些自主结构以令人不安的效率拦截和消除威胁，通过协调破坏和不懈追击来瓦解敌人的编队。
entries.en: An adaptive strike craft formed from self-replicating nanites, the Interdictor prioritizes control over chaos. Operating as a cohesive unit, these autonomous constructs intercept and neutralize threats with unnerving efficiency, unraveling enemy formations through coordinated disruption and relentless pursuit.

entries.zh: 天灾护卫舰设计用于快速爆发以压倒性数量碾压一切。它们比正常的护卫舰更出色，让那些将至之风暴的反对者们感到恐惧。
entries.en: Crisis Corvettes are designed for rapid deployment and overwhelming force through sheer numbers. They outclass standard corvettes, striking fear into those who oppose the coming storm.

entries.zh: 一种以无情高效为设计理念的重装甲战舰。比护卫舰更重更耐用，可以射出压倒性火力，又能保持极高的航速追杀逃亡的敌军。
entries.en: A heavily armed warship designed for ruthless efficiency. Larger and more durable than corvettes, it delivers overwhelming firepower while maintaining the speed to hunt down fleeing foes.

entries.zh: 一种在火力、耐久和战略支配力上平衡的强大战舰。它装甲厚重防御坚固，可以作为此后猛烈进攻中的中流砥柱，以强大的力量撕毁敌军防线。
entries.en: A formidable warship that balances firepower, durability, and strategic dominance. Heavily armed and resilient, it serves as the backbone of the coming onslaught, breaking enemy lines with relentless force.

entries.zh: 一种可以吞噬整颗恒星的硕大舰船，它通过出发超新星爆发来摧毁整个恒星系。焚天神兵不仅仅是战舰，它是星系末日的先驱，在前进的路上让无数星球化为了无生机的虚空。
entries.en: This colossal vessel is capable of consuming entire stars, triggering supernovae that annihilate entire systems. More than just a warship, the Star Eater is a harbinger of the galaxy's end, reducing worlds to lifeless voids in its path.

entries.zh: 一艘充满宇宙能量的光鲜战舰，以精确和无情的力量进行打击。它不仅仅是一艘舰船，更是新现实的先兆。
entries.en: A sleek warship infused with cosmic energies, striking with precision and relentless force. More than a vessel, it is a harbinger of the new reality.

entries.zh: 科技和命运的崇高融合，拥有毁灭性的火力。这种战舰能重塑战场，如同其主人重塑星河一般。
entries.en: A towering fusion of science and destiny, wielding devastating firepower. This warship reshapes battlefields as its masters reshape the stars.

entries.zh: 这是属于宇宙的战争引擎，散发着骤变将至的力量。它的存在扭曲了现实，预示着宇宙重生的曙光。
entries.en: A celestial war engine, radiating the power of impending transformation. Its very presence bends reality, heralding the dawn of a universe reborn.
